summary: Comfort persona (persona-config.ts:503-555) auto-serves a rotating comfort-chapter reading with a guided-prayer verse banner, a gentle post-read flow, and pastoral-care/988 copy — but has no code-level crisis detection anywhere in the AI path; safety is entirely static copy plus a softer system prompt.
first_visit: First mount: HomeScreen greeting rotates through comfort-specific lines keyed to day-of-month (persona-config.ts:144-152, 254-262). No streak counter shown (HomeScreen.tsx:2004-2006). No "Choose Your Plan" funnel button (HomeScreen.tsx:2856-2857) — comfort has auto-served content. sectionOrder renders in order: greeting, comfort_verse_banner, hero_audio, scripture, comfort_scripture, ai_prompt, comfort_card(retired), book_cards (persona-config.ts:510-519). Hero reading panel auto-fills from COMFORT_CHAPTERS via localDayIndex() when no plan/slots exist (HomeScreen.tsx:1298-1305). The plain "scripture" section renders nothing for comfort/new_to_faith when no plan/slots exist, to avoid mislabeling auto-served content as "no plan active" (HomeScreen.tsx:3435-3441).
return_visit: Same greeting rotation (deterministic by date, not visit count). ComfortSection re-derives today's comfort chapter from localDayIndex() (ComfortSection.tsx:20-23, 49-51) — same chapter all day regardless of visit count. If the user previously set a daily-chapter amount (dw_comfort_daily), ComfortSection auto-advances through that many chapters per day without re-asking (ComfortSection.tsx:54-56, 65-79). Streak persists silently (recorded but not surfaced).
completion_and_streak: Streak: recordStreakToday() runs on HomeScreen mount for every persona including comfort (HomeScreen.tsx:545 per CLAUDE.md/streak.ts convention) but the streak UI is explicitly suppressed for comfort (HomeScreen.tsx:2004-2006, comment "hidden for new_to_faith + comfort to avoid pressure"). Reading-done stamp: dw_reading_done is set to the local (en-CA) date the first time the last hero chapter ref is reached (HomeScreen.tsx:596, 1562-1564), which fires window event 'dw-reading-completed' (HomeScreen.tsx:598) — comfort's auto-served chapter feeds this same hero pipeline via heroChapterRefs (HomeScreen.tsx:1298-1305) so it stamps the same generic way as other personas. Separately, ComfortSection keeps its own local, non-persisted counter comfortChaptersServed / comfortPostRead state machine (ComfortSection.tsx:52-53) that drives the in-section "read another?" / "set a daily amount" flow and is not the app's streak.
audio: Hero panel audio uses the shared listen/play machinery (persona-config.ts:513 lists 'hero_audio' in sectionOrder, but the literal string 'hero_audio' is never referenced in HomeScreen.tsx — grep returned zero hits — so it is rendered by the shared, non-gated hero audio controls, not a distinct branch). ComfortSection has its own Listen/Pause button (ComfortSection.tsx:129-146) wired to the audioPlaying/audioLoading/audioCurrentPassage/handleListen props passed down from HomeScreen, sharing state with the hero player.
ai: ai_prompt section renders BibleAIPromptSection which opens the shared BibleAI modal (HomeScreen.tsx:3109, setShowBibleAI). Comfort gets a distinct system-prompt addition (persona-config.ts:549-553): "This person is going through a difficult time. Be warm, compassionate, and encouraging above all. Lead with comfort before teaching... Keep responses shorter and gentler. If they express deep distress, gently encourage them to talk to their pastor or a trusted friend." Grep of src/components/BibleAI.tsx and netlify/functions/claude.js for 988, crisis, suicide, self-harm, lifeline, hotline returned zero matches in either file — there is no keyword-triggered crisis detection, escalation, or hard-coded 988 insertion in the AI request/response path; the softer tone is the only built-in safety behavior for the AI itself.
copy_keys: Pastoral care hardcoded English strings, not i18n keys: 'Need to talk to someone?', 'Reach Out', 'Crisis support: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (call or text 988)' (MoreScreen.tsx:790-838)
self_serve_levers: Ashley can add/remove comfort chapters/devotions by editing src/data/comfort.ts (COMFORT_CHAPTERS, COMFORT_DEVOTIONS) — no code logic change needed.
Daily reading amount (1/2/3 chapters) is user-chosen in-app via the ask_lock step (ComfortSection.tsx:305-327), stored in dw_comfort_daily and synced via syncMisc (ComfortSection.tsx:315).
Comfort verses and guided prayers are plain arrays in ComfortVerseBannerSection.tsx:13-37 — editable without touching render logic.
Featured plan categories/book cards for comfort are declared data in persona-config.ts:534 (bookCards) and 538 (featuredCategories) — swappable by editing the array.
dev_needed_today: Any crisis-keyword detection or AI-side escalation logic (e.g. real-time 988 surfacing inside BibleAI responses) — none exists; would need new code in src/components/BibleAI.tsx and/or netlify/functions/claude.js.
Localizing/i18n-keying the pastoral-care block and 988 line in MoreScreen.tsx:790-838 — currently hardcoded English strings, not run through t()/trans().

Changing which sectionOrder keys actually render — 'hero_audio' and 'comfort_card' are declared in persona-config.ts:513,517 but have no corresponding gated render block in HomeScreen.tsx (comfort_card is explicitly retired per ComfortVerseBannerSection.tsx:6); wiring or removing dead keys is a code change.
Adjusting the auto-advance / ask-flow thresholds (e.g. the hardcoded '>= 2' before ask_lock at ComfortSection.tsx:77) requires editing ComfortSection.tsx directly — not exposed as a lever.
Changing the streak-suppression rule for comfort (HomeScreen.tsx:2006) is a conditional in code, not a config toggle.
